verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. Logo is centred at the top, a small 'Glow' sits in the middle, the product is pushed to the far left and the CTA to the far right. In both, the product can is tiny and jammed near the left edge, its base touches the cropped decorative circle, the headline is too small to anchor the wide banner, and the elements are spread out with dead space between them. A is slightly worse because its CTA runs almost to the right canvas edge. B leaves a slightly more even right margin, but its product looks a little narrower.
